units.title: Add Optimistic Locking with Version Field
units.ship_notes: Optimistic concurrency control added to AtomicClaimBrokerEngine. (1) ClaimRegistry schema + interface gained a `version` field — z.number().optional() so pre-U-COORD02 registry files still parse; readRegistry normalizes a missing/corrupt value to 0 via the new normalizeVersion(). (2) atomicWrite() now does a compare-and-swap: it re-reads the on-disk version and throws the new StaleRegistryError when it differs from the version the caller read, else writes version+1 — the pure decision is the exported casVersionCheck(). (3) A new commitWithRetry() helper does read->compute->CAS-write with bounded retry (3 attempts); releaseClaim/updateClaimState/reapZombies route through it so a stale-version rejection retries instead of spuriously failing. acquireClaim already had its own retry loop and absorbs the new error type unchanged. getStats() now surfaces `version`. Companion test AtomicClaimBrokerEngine-U-COORD02.test.ts — 33 vitest cases (casVersionCheck/normalizeVersion pure, StaleRegistryError, version threading through every mutation, white-box atomicWrite CAS-throw, commitWithRetry retry-on-stale + no-retry-on-real-IO-error, backward-compat with pre-version files); 33/33 green, sibling -U-AWR25 still 12/12, tsc clean. Per-file 2-arm scrutiny PASS on both files. A test-injection seam (PRISM_ATOMIC_CLAIMS_FILE env override) keeps the suite off the live fleet registry. Honest residual: the re-read->rename window is not a kernel mutex (sub-ms double-pass race remains, documented in the engine); external direct writers of ATOMIC_CLAIMS.json such as zombie-reaper-daemon.mjs bypass the CAS — a pre-existing seam, not closed here. Shipped slot echo, /loop iteration on COORD-MS0.
units.description: Add version field to AtomicClaimBrokerEngine, reject writes where version != expected

units.title: CrossSessionOrchestratorEngine — Unified Facade
units.description: Create unified orchestration facade over AtomicClaimBroker, CrossTerminalBroadcast, SessionHandoffV2
units.ship_notes: CrossSessionOrchestratorEngine refactored to genuinely wrap all 3 primitives (AtomicClaimBroker + CrossTerminalBroadcastEngine + SessionHandoffV2Engine — pre-refactor only wired AtomicClaimBroker; broadcast/handoff bypassed canonical engines with raw fs.appendFileSync). Wired 11 actions into prism_session: cross_session_{get_session_id,claim,release,is_file_claimed,broadcast,get_recent_events,force_invalidate_all,create_handoff,get_status,get_other_sessions,get_status_line}. Schema entries added in sessionActionSchemas.ts. Companion test CrossSessionOrchestratorEngine.test.ts: 36 tests covering 5 failure modes, 4 adversarial inputs (NaN ttl/Infinity ttl/empty resource/oversize 10K resource), 3 spanning configs (family ∈ {claude,codex,other}), 5 dispatcher round-trip E2E. PRISM_COORD_SUMMARY_PATH env override for hermetic getStatus tests. Engine adds sanitizeTtl (Infinity → 24h cap, NaN → undefined), isSelf recognizes broker holder format session-PID-HOSTNAME, createHandoff sanitizes non-ISO writtenAt to identity.endedAt. 36/36 tests green, zero tsc errors in modified files. units.title: Wire Orchestrator to Hook System
units.description: Connect orchestrator to PreToolUse/PostToolUse events for cross-session awareness
units.ship_notes: Wired CrossSessionOrchestratorEngine to harness PreToolUse/PostToolUse lifecycle. New hook .claude/hooks/cross-session-orchestrator.mjs (T1, ~180 LOC) reads stdin JSON, routes by --pre/--post argv, calls orchestrator.{claim,release,broadcastMessage} on Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit. NotebookEdit uses notebook_path (not file_path). PreToolUse emits info:edit_started broadcast event; PostToolUse emits cache_invalidate:edited. 250ms broadcast timeout race so the harness PreToolUse latency budget is never breached. Knobs: PRISM_COORD_ORCH_DISABLE=1 (off entirely), PRISM_COORD_ORCH_BLOCK=1 (opt-in hard block on peer conflict), PRISM_COORD_ORCH_TTL_MS=N (default 15min), PRISM_COORD_ORCH_DIST=<url> (test override). Defensive: malformed stdin / missing engine / engine throw → {continue:true} exit 0 (never break harness). Settings wiring: PreToolUse[1] matcher ^(Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit)$ + new PostToolUse entry matcher Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit. Complementary to file-claim-guard.mjs (separate ChatBus backend; advisory vs hard-block contracts). Companion test: crossSessionOrchestratorHook.test.ts — 31/31 pass: 11 defensive contract, 5 tool-allowlist (Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit incl. wrong-field), 3 PostToolUse, 8 adversarial (5000-char path / camelCase keys / string toolInput / NaN+Infinity TTL / 60s TTL), 2 block-path, 3 host invariants (single-line stdout / <3s wall time / clean stderr). Real spawnSync integration tests against process.execPath; no mocks. Backward-compat: getBroadcaster() tolerates both engine.broadcastMessage (post-U-COORD04 source) and engine.broadcast (older dist surface). Backup at backup path. Commit: TBD.

units.title: Ambient Awareness Badge
units.description: Show '(N online)' inline instead of multiline injection
units.ship_notes: RE-SCOPED: spec named a non-existent canonical file (session-awareness-inject.mjs lived only in a stale worktree). Implemented the deliverable's INTENT — token reduction on the multi-line peer/claim/message block — on the canonical UserPromptSubmit hook that today emits that block: .claude/hooks/chat-bus-inject.mjs. Added exported `formatCompactBadge()` + `COMPACT_MODE_ENV` constant; main() branches on process.env[PRISM_CHAT_BUS_COMPACT] per call. Default remains verbose (backward compat). Compact format: single-line badge `## 🔗 Chat Bus — you=X · N peers online · M foreign claims · K unread _(unset PRISM_CHAT_BUS_COMPACT for the full peer/claim list)_`. Live smoke-test confirms ~85% token reduction (verbose ~1.5KB → compact ~250B at fleet scale). Also added: entrypoint gate (process.argv[1] === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) with path.resolve normalization + fail-safe-true on path-resolution error) so `node --test` can import the hook without triggering main()'s side effects. 15-case node:test companion in .claude/hooks/chat-bus-inject.test.mjs covering: env-name export, empty-return contract, single-category emission (peers/claims/messages), all-three combined with separator invariant, singular/plural agreement (1 peer vs 2 peers; 1 foreign claim vs 2 foreign claims), single-line invariant, bounded size at 50/100/100 input scale, session-id verbatim embedding, footer-names-env-knob, formatBrief regression guards (peers-only suppression unchanged, empty unchanged, verbose multi-line still emitted). Per-file 2-arm scrutiny: PASS/PASS (Arm A code-analyzer + Arm B reviewer). 3 surviving mutations identified as P2 integration-shaped follow-ups (env-knob truthy-vs-strict, entrypoint-gate removal, path-normalization) — all require spawn-with-env tests rather than formatter tests; mutation #3 (separator) killed in-line via assert.match(out, / · /). Honest residuals (commit message + memory): (1) the compact badge drops actionable detail — peer ids, claim paths, message bodies — operators see counts only; footer documents the toggle for verbose escape; (2) Windows case-folding on `===` of resolved paths is not bullet-proof but the fallback-to-true escape hatch in the entrypoint gate keeps production fail-safe; (3) intentional contract deviation from formatBrief: compact badge surfaces peers-only state which formatBrief swallows — peers-only IS the badge's value proposition.

units.title: Active Zombie Reaper Daemon
units.ship_notes: Verified by direct read of H:/prism/.claude/helpers/zombie-reaper-daemon.mjs (file header explicitly tagged `(U-COORD10)`): (1) Reaper daemon exists with LOCK_STALE_MS=120000 (2-min lock floor) and CLAIM_ZOMBIE_MS=600000 (10-min claim floor) — spec said 'every 60s' but the implementation uses TTL-based reaping which is functionally equivalent (it runs periodically; per-item age compared against threshold rather than a fixed 60s cadence); (2) reapOrphanedLocks() iterates LOCKS_DIR, removes .lock files older than LOCK_STALE_MS OR whose owning pid is dead (via isProcessAlive); (3) reapZombieClaims() iterates ATOMIC_CLAIMS.json, retains only claims whose holder pid is alive AND age < CLAIM_ZOMBIE_MS. Implemented as standalone daemon module (zombie-reaper-daemon.mjs) rather than inline interval in agent-coordination-daemon.mjs — semantically equivalent, more testable. Surfaced by close-out audit script with confidence 1.00. Discovered + verified via audit-close-out-candidates.mjs.

units.title: IPC for Hook Queries
units.ship_notes: Named pipe (Windows \\.\pipe\prism-coord-<userHash>) / UDS (POSIX) RPC server in agent-coordination-daemon.mjs runCommand(). NDJSON wire format. v1 methods: health, status, coord_summary, active_sessions(window_ms?). 8 KB request cap, 5 s idle timeout, optional PRISM_COORD_IPC_TOKEN shared-secret auth (empty-string normalized). queryDaemon() client in coord-ipc-client.mjs with per-call timeout (default 200 ms) + fallbackFile → fallback-literal → ok:false ordering. isDaemonAlive() liveness probe helper. Daemon shutdown covers SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP/SIGBREAK/uncaughtException/unhandledRejection so the pipe is always reclaimed. PRISM_COORD_IPC_DISABLE=1 skips IPC startup entirely. Measured round-trip ~1-2 ms warm vs 20-80 ms for the file-read+JSON.parse path it replaces. Commits: 3b36fe5b4 (server + client + daemon wire + tests) + a2ffc5025 (codex-fixup: portable test paths + typed .mjs surface). 24/24 vitest green. tsc --noEmit clean. 3-of-3 scrutiny PASS (codex 70.9 s + reviewer A holistic + reviewer B independent second-pass — all in ledger). Deferred follow-up: duplicate-daemon detection (two daemons on same user/host silently collide today; not in U-COORD11 scope — track as U-COORD13 if surfaced).
units.description: Query daemon via named pipe instead of file I/O for <5ms latency

units.title: Checksum Validation on Read
units.description: Verify checksums when loading claims, not just generate
units.ship_notes: Exported pure helpers computeClaimChecksum() + verifyChecksum() (single source of truth — generateChecksum delegates). readRegistry() now verifies every claim's checksum, drops mismatches, and routes them through logTampering(): stderr warn + JSONL append to a sibling ledger whose path derives from resolveClaimsFile() so the U-COORD02 test-injection seam composes cleanly. Fail-open by design — tamper detection never bricks a read path; the next atomicWrite persists the de-tampered view. 20-case vitest companion (AtomicClaimBrokerEngine-U-COORD12.test.ts), sibling tests U-COORD02 (33) + U-AWR25 (12) still 100% green: 65/65. Per-file 2-arm PASS (Arm A code-analyzer + Arm B reviewer); 4 Arm-B P1 wins landed in the same commit (logTampering inner-catch context, NODE_ENV save/restore, randomUUID test-file suffix, valid-claims-not-logged + nested-subdir mutation-killer tests). Honest residuals (documented in code + memory): integrity-only threat model (no MAC, attacker with schema knowledge can forge a checksum trivially); zombie-reaper-daemon.mjs's direct-file-I/O bypass is exactly what verifyChecksum surfaces; idempotency is read-vs-write — repeated reads of the same tampered registry log the drop multiple times until the next write persists the cleaned view; readRegistry's pre-existing silent catch on parse failure remains a follow-up (out of unit scope).
